description: Tiny demonstration benchmark for the FailureLens baseline. This is NOT a performance claim - it is a single reproducible case used to exercise the evaluation harness end to end. Add more labelled cases here as real, license-cleared data becomes available (see datasets/README.md).

cases.label_rationale: The ZeroDivisionError surfaces in divide(), but the root cause is average(), which fails to guard against an empty input sequence (see the function docstrings in calculator/core.py).
